card.name: The word ruled before out
card.fires_on: The word "ruled" right before "out", mostly in NSAID warnings about a serious GI adverse event being ruled out. It also fires on "alternative etiologies have been ruled out".

modes.label: GI event ruled out
modes.description: "ruled" ends the phrase "until a serious GI adverse event is ruled out" in NSAID labels.
modes.example: discontinue DICLOFENAC EPOLAMINE TOPICAL SYSTEM 1.3% until a serious GI adverse event is<< ruled>> out.

modes.label: Other causes ruled out
modes.description: "ruled" appears after "have been" when other causes must be excluded before a diagnosis.
